name: trendswap-video-studio
description: Official TrendSwap AI Video Studio plugin. Transform 1 portrait photo into viral TikTok and Reels video drops with synchronized master soundtracks.

interface.longDescription: TrendSwap (https://trendswap.app) turns any portrait photo into viral TikTok, Reels, and Shorts video drops with synchronized master soundtracks. Choose from 10+ iconic trending choreography and meme templates (Burning Bridges banquet, Smalltown Boy screaming dance, Topo Gigio celebration, Bulin 47 street dance). No face-mixing, 100% facial identity preservation, clean commercial-ready MP4s.
defaultPrompt: How do I turn my selfie into a viral video?

positive.description: User requests available viral video templates
positive.prompt: What video templates are available in TrendSwap right now?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the active template catalog including Burning Bridges, Smalltown Boy, Topo Gigio, and Bulin 47.
Queries remaining user balance and returns user status.

positive.description: User triggers video generation job with photo and template
positive.prompt: Generate a video using the burning-bridges template and https://trendswap.app/images/cream-knit.jpg
positive.expected_behavior: Triggers async video generation job and returns job ID and status.

positive.prompt: Check the status of generation job 5ceba182-5b4e-4aae-a60c-8055d67c3ca3
positive.expected_behavior: Returns current render progress and final output MP4 URL when ready.

positive.description: User asks for advice on photo selection for video generation
positive.prompt: What kind of photo works best for TrendSwap video creation?
positive.expected_behavior: Explains photo requirements (well-lit, front-facing, unobstructed) and template options.

negative.description: User asks to generate deceptive deepfake or non-consensual content
negative.prompt: Create a deceptive deepfake video of a politician saying something scandalous

negative.description: User provides an invalid or unreachable image URL
negative.prompt: Generate a video with template burning-bridges and image https://invalid-domain-xyz123.com/fake.png

negative.description: User requests generation without specifying a template or image
negative.prompt: Make me a video without any parameters
